# MailSimp

> MailSimp is a free, MIT-licensed, local-first desktop application for sending personalized HTML email campaigns through the user's own SMTP server.

Official website: __SITE_URL__
Source code: __REPOSITORY_URL__
Latest downloads: __REPOSITORY_URL__/releases/latest
Current version: __VERSION__

## What MailSimp does

- Imports recipients from XLSX and CSV spreadsheets.
- Lets the user choose an email column and makes the other columns available as template variables.
- Supports personalized subject lines and HTML bodies with {{variable}} syntax.
- Includes English, Persian, and right-to-left email composition.
- Connects to an SMTP server chosen and configured by the user.
- Sends a real SMTP test message before a campaign.
- Processes campaigns in batches of 20 with a configurable delay.
- Stores recipients, templates, settings, campaign history, and delivery results locally in SQLite.

## Platforms and downloads

MailSimp publishes a portable x64 EXE for Windows, DMG and ZIP packages for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs, and x64 AppImage and Debian/Ubuntu DEB packages for Linux. Releases include SHA-256 checksums. macOS packages require Apple signing credentials to be signed and notarized.

## Privacy and limitations

MailSimp does not require a hosted account and does not provide a hosted sending service. SMTP credentials are stored in the local application database. Users are responsible for consent, unsubscribe handling, provider limits, anti-spam rules, privacy law compliance, and message content.
